.re-mdp{position:relative;display:inline-block;font:400 13px/20px Inter,'Inter Variable',InterVariable,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#000000e0;text-align:left}.re-mdp *{box-sizing:border-box}.re-mdp button{font:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}.re-mdp__trigger{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:28px;padding:0 6px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:none;font-weight:500!important;color:#0000009c!important;transition:background .16s,color .16s}.re-mdp__trigger:hover,.re-mdp[data-open=true] .re-mdp__trigger{background:#00000008;color:#000000e0!important}.re-mdp__trigger:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #3986fa73;outline-offset:1px}.re-mdp__trigger:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}.re-mdp__glyph{width:20px;height:20px;flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#fff;color:#000;border-radius:5px;box-shadow:0 0 0 .5px #0000001a,0 1px 1px -1px #0000001a;font-size:10px;font-weight:500;line-height:10px;overflow:hidden}.re-mdp__glyph svg{width:12px;height:12px}.re-mdp__trigger .re-mdp__glyph{width:18px;height:18px}.re-mdp__name{position:relative;display:grid;white-space:nowrap}.re-mdp__name>span{grid-area:1/1}.re-mdp__chevron{flex:none;color:#00000073;transition:transform .32s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,.24,1)}.re-mdp[data-open=true] .re-mdp__chevron{transform:rotate(180deg)}.re-mdp__indicator{display:grid;grid-template-columns:0fr;opacity:0;margin-left:-6px;color:rgba(0,96,226,.765);transition:grid-template-columns .36s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,.24,1),opacity .28s,margin-left .36s}.re-mdp__indicator>span{overflow:hidden;min-width:0;display:flex;align-items:center}.re-mdp__indicator[data-visible=true]{grid-template-columns:1fr;opacity:1;margin-left:-2px;transition-delay:0s,.08s,0s}.re-mdp__indicator svg{min-width:16px}.re-mdp__pop{position:absolute;z-index:20;top:calc(100% + 6px);left:0;width:320px;max-width:calc(100vw - 32px);background:white;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 0 0 .5px #00000014,0 12px 28px -10px #00000029,0 1px 2px #0000000d;opacity:0;transform:translateY(-4px) scale(.96);visibility:hidden;transform-origin:top left;transition:opacity .2s,transform .32s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,.24,1),visibility 0s .32s}.re-mdp[data-open=true] .re-mdp__pop{opacity:1;transform:none;visibility:visible;transition-delay:0s}.re-mdp[data-align=end] .re-mdp__pop{left:auto;right:0;transform-origin:top right}.re-mdp[data-side=top] .re-mdp__pop{top:auto;bottom:calc(100% + 6px);transform-origin:bottom left}.re-mdp[data-side=top][data-align=end] .re-mdp__pop{transform-origin:bottom right}.re-mdp__card{padding:4px}.re-mdp__head{height:28px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:4px 8px 0;gap:12px;font-size:10px;line-height:16px;letter-spacing:.5px;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:500;color:#00000073}.re-mdp__columns,.re-mdp__bars{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,40px);gap:8px;flex:none}.re-mdp__columns{text-align:center}.re-mdp__list{max-height:360px;overflow:auto;border-radius:6px;outline:none}.re-mdp__option{height:48px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:6px;cursor:default;transition:background .09s ease-out,opacity .2s}.re-mdp__list[data-pointing] .re-mdp__option:not([data-active]){opacity:.45}.re-mdp__list[data-pointing] .re-mdp__option[data-active]{background:#0000000f}.re-mdp__list[data-keyboard] .re-mdp__option[data-active]{background:#0000000f;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #3986fa73}.re-mdp__option[aria-disabled=true]{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}.re-mdp__text{min-width:0;flex:1;display:block}.re-mdp__title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;line-height:20px;font-weight:500;color:#000;white-space:nowrap}.re-mdp__title>span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.re-mdp__description{display:block;font-size:12px;line-height:16px;color:#0000009c;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.re-mdp__check{flex:none;color:rgba(0,96,226,.765);animation:re-mdp-pop .32s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,.24,1) both}.re-mdp__meter{display:flex;gap:2px;height:4px}.re-mdp__segment{display:block;height:4px;flex:1;background:#0000000f;border-radius:1px;transition:background .18s,transform .26s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,.24,1)}.re-mdp__segment[data-on]{background:#00000033}.re-mdp__option[data-active] .re-mdp__segment[data-on]{background:rgba(0,96,226,.765);transition-delay:var(--delay);animation:re-mdp-fill .36s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,.24,1) var(--delay) both}.re-mdp__varies{width:136px;flex:none;text-align:center;font-size:12px;line-height:16px;color:#00000073}.re-mdp__extra{margin:4px -4px 0;border-top:1px solid #0000000f;padding:4px 4px 0}.re-mdp__foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;min-height:36px;border-top:1px solid #0000000f;padding:6px 8px 6px 12px}.re-mdp__caption{font-size:12px;line-height:16px;color:#00000073;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap}.re-mdp__caption b{font-weight:500;color:#000000e0;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.re-mdp__dot{color:#00000045}.re-mdp__keys{display:flex;gap:2px;flex:none}.re-mdp kbd{display:grid;place-items:center;font:11px/16px Inter,'Inter Variable',system-ui,sans-serif;min-width:20px;height:20px;padding:0 4px;border-radius:4px;color:#00000073;box-shadow:0 0 0 .5px #0000001f}.re-mdp__sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;clip-path:inset(50%);overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap}.re-mdp__empty{padding:20px;text-align:center;color:#00000073}@keyframes re-mdp-fill{0%,100%{transform:scaleY(1)}45%{transform:scaleY(1.6)}}@keyframes re-mdp-pop{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.5)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}}@media(max-width:340px){.re-mdp__columns,.re-mdp__bars{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,32px);gap:4px}.re-mdp__varies{width:104px}.re-mdp__option{gap:6px}.re-mdp__keys{display:none}.re-mdp__option .re-mdp__glyph{display:none}}@media(pointer:coarse){.re-mdp__trigger{height:36px}.re-mdp__option{height:52px}.re-mdp__keys{display:none}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.re-mdp *{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

.re-mdp__caption{display:grid;position:relative}.re-mdp__caption>span{grid-area:1/1}.re-mdp__missing{font-size:11px;line-height:4px;color:#00000073;flex:1;text-align:center}
